measurement_window: minimum baro trust AFTER arm_time, which is the only window the rule can fire in. StressRun.min_trust spans the whole run including warm-up from the 0.8 prior, and that whole-run minimum is 0.8182 (9/11) in EVERY campaign run whatever is faulted -- an early-flight artifact, not a fault response. Reading it as GPS starving baro of its only corroborating edge was a misreading, corrected here: runs faulting only battery and imu1, GPS healthy, report the identical 0.8182.
nothing_is_tuned_by_this_module: whatever the rate, the threshold is not adjusted here. An unacceptable rate is reported and the rule withdrawn or re-scoped; moving the number until the answer looks right is the failure mode this programme exists to avoid.
